ModMetaData.name: Faster Game Loading - Continued
ModMetaData.author: 綠菇
ModMetaData.description:
=== Does loading take forever? This mod is for you! ===
Sick of staring at the loading screen every time you start RimWorld? This mod cuts down startup time using several tricks that work in the background, so the game loads faster without changing any gameplay.
--- What it does ---
- Early mod content loading: Starts loading pending mod content during idle loading gaps before RimWorld's normal ReloadContentInt pass reaches those mods, beginning only after every mod has finished initializing so their patches apply; stops once play data has loaded. (enabled by default) - Multi-threaded preloading: Speeds up XML loading and type resolution by utilizing multiple CPU cores. (enabled by default) - Type lookup cache: Warms full type names before XML parsing and remembers resolved names across sessions; invalidates stale assembly mappings. (enabled by default) - Trim static atlases: Removes empty rows while preserving pixel positions and aligning every mip level for GPU compression. (enabled by default) - Skip duplicate atlas textures: Shares Building textures with Item and Misc when mask states are unambiguous; preserves copies with conflicting mask states. (enabled by default) - Faster atlas compression: Uses standard-quality compression on the CPU path; GPU compression is unchanged. (disabled by default) - Delay graphic and icon loading: Delays non-essential textures until after entering a game; essential categories are checked after Def references resolve, and RimWorld resolves icons before atlas baking. (disabled by default) - Adaptive atlas baking: Used together with delayed graphic loading; bakes the deferred atlases one per frame, sized from your GPU speed but never smaller than 1024x1024, and keeps RimWorld 1.6 vanilla atlas pre-inserts intact. Without delayed graphic loading, vanilla baking is used. (disabled by default) - Verbose logging: Outputs debug messages to the console. (disabled by default) - Texture downscaler: Runs behind a loading screen and saves reduced copies of high-resolution textures in a separate cache. Original files remain untouched; cache entries for active mods survive mod-list changes, and UI textures retain their no-mipmap behavior. (manual tool)
--- Things to know ---
- The game may briefly freeze or feel unresponsive during startup. This is normal — the mod is doing work in the background. - It may take a while to get any sound after entering the main menu, which is normal; sound playback is released automatically after deferred sound definitions finish resolving. - When delay graphic loading is disabled, static atlases are not baked again by the delayed startup cleanup, preventing duplicate atlas VRAM usage with large race or texture-heavy mods. - FGL's guard against loading the same AssetBundles twice runs before ChezhouLib's AssetBundle loader; otherwise ChezhouLib's loader would skip the guard entirely. - Early mod content loading now includes official Core/DLC packs as well as player mods. - For Graphics Settings+ (Optimize Texture), the texture downscaler will step aside. (Converting to DDS is actually more efficient and has higher quality than directly downscaled images, so it is recommended to use the texture downscaler only when you cannot use such tools) - Image Opt compatibility is no longer maintained. When both mods are enabled together, mods that depend on Ancot Library may show missing or black textures under some loading conditions; the remaining safeguards (downscaled-texture bypass, invalid .dds cache cleanup) do not guarantee compatibility. Using both mods together is not recommended; use Image Opt fork (Steam Workshop id 3781013698) instead, an alternative patched by its author for compatibility with this mod. Load it after this mod.
--- Works well with ---
- Loading Progress - Missile Girl - Performance Mod or DefLoadCache (choose one) - Graphics Settings+ - Hyperdrive (parallel Defs XML loading is left to Hyperdrive)
--- Works best with a lot of mods. Zero impact on gameplay or saves. ---
Original mod by Taranchuk. This is a maintained fork with bug fixes and improvements.
